prompts.modelSheet: Three isolated full-body Jordan views on pure magenta: front, back, and profile, with rust-orange beanie, messy brown hair, orange puffer vest, cream sweater, olive cargo pants, brown hiking boots, and holographic backpack with mountain, pine, tent, and compass stickers.
prompts.walkDown: Six isolated head-on front walk poses, contact/down/passing twice, stable Jordan costume on pure magenta.
prompts.walkUp: Regenerated after the first strips accidentally turned three-quarter: two three-frame strips from the isolated approved back-view crop, with square shoulders, centred backpack, no cheek or face, and only arms and legs alternating.
prompts.walkLeft: Six isolated right-facing side-profile walk poses, contact/down/passing twice, stable Jordan costume on pure magenta; flopped for shipped left direction.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-jordan.ts (extracts whole connected components and rebuilds the atlas)
postProcessing.extract: extract-strip.ts with connected-component extraction; generated strips include one detached horizontal artifact component, which the deterministic builder extracts and skips before selecting the six or three figures
postProcessing.key: #FF00FF border flood plus enclosed holes, 18% fuzz, edge-only despill over a 12 px alpha-edge band
postProcessing.side: The side walk strip was generated facing right and its six extracted frames are flopped to face left. The model sheet side view is used as drawn for left_idle_01 because validate-sprite.ts confirms it faces left as drawn.
postProcessing.backWalk: The original back walk was rejected because frames swivelled into three-quarter views, visibly shifting the backpack and exposing a cheek. The approved back-view crop was extracted from the model sheet, then used to regenerate two selected three-frame strips. Every shipped frame is straight-on with a centred backpack and only limb changes.
postProcessing.despill: build-jordan.ts explicitly runs despill-edge.ts with magenta and band 12 after every postprocessed frame.
postProcessing.idle: Down and up idles come from the model-sheet front and back views; left idle comes from the model-sheet side view as drawn.

selectionReason: The model sheet preserves Jordan's autumn costume and backpack details at the Sue/Fae scale. The replacement back strips specifically correct the prior three-quarter shoulder swivel: all six back-walk frames are square to camera, have no cheek or face, and keep the backpack centred. The final atlas passes all mandatory sprite checks after connected-component extraction, magenta keying, and edge-only despill.
